page.heading: What the agent knows
page.intro: Knowledge base items come from the form, in the {link} tab. You can also add texts (with an image) here.
page.mediaTakenOver: To train with websites and videos, go back to the form in advanced mode there.
page.mediaTurnOn: To train with websites and videos, turn on advanced mode there.
page.mediaAdvanced: In advanced mode, websites and videos are added here.
page.searchPlaceholder: Search text, address or file name
page.emptyDescription: Fill in the knowledge base in the form on the Function tab and publish, or add a text here.
page.actionError: Could not complete the action. Try again.
page.exportEmpty: There are no manual trainings to export.
page.exportImages: The file keeps the link to the images, not the images themselves. Anyone with the file can open them while they exist on this agent.
page.expiredHint: Removed from the agent; only the record stays here.

add.title: Add training
add.description: The agent learns from the content and starts using it in its answers.

TEXT.label: Text
TEXT.hint: A text, with an image if you want

add.videoHint: E.g., a YouTube video explaining the product.
add.subPagesHint: The agent learns from the website pages starting at this address.
add.refreshHint: For websites that change often, such as catalogs and prices.
add.error: Could not send the training. Try again.

edit.title: Edit text
edit.description: The agent starts using the new text and image in its answers.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid. Review them and try again.
errors.AGENT_OUT_OF_SYNC: The agent was not found in GPTMaker; contact support.
errors.TRAINING_NOT_EDITABLE: Only text trainings can be edited; remove this one and create another.
errors.TRAINING_NOT_READY: The training is still being registered in GPTMaker; try again shortly.
errors.TRAINING_NOT_FAILED: Only failed trainings can be resent.
errors.TRAINING_NOT_RETRYABLE: This document's file is not stored here; remove it and upload the document again.
errors.TRAINING_BUSY: Another training for this agent is being sent; try again shortly.
errors.TRAINING_MANAGED_BY_FUNCTION: This training comes from the agent's function form; change the item there.
errors.TRAINING_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND: Image not found; upload the image again.
errors.TRAINING_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image exceeds the maximum allowed size.
errors.TRAINING_IMAGE_INVALID_TYPE: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are accepted.
errors.TRAINING_IMAGE_IN_USE: This image is already used in another training; upload the image again.
errors.PLAN_TRAINING_LIMIT: You have reached your plan's training limit. Remove some or change plans.
errors.GPTMAKER_REJECTED: GPTMaker rejected the training. Review the content and try again.
errors.GPTMAKER_UNAVAILABLE: Could not send the training to GPTMaker right now. Try again shortly.
errors.TRAINING_IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: This file version is not supported. Export the trainings again.
errors.TRAINING_IMPORT_TOO_MANY: The file exceeds the limit of trainings per import.
errors.TRAINING_IMPORT_INVALID_FILE: The file is not a valid trainings export.
errors.TRAINING_IMPORT_BUSY: Another import is in progress; try again shortly.
errors.TRAINING_EXPIRED: This training has expired and was removed from the agent.
errors.TRAINING_MANAGED_NO_SETTINGS: Training generated by the function accepts neither tags nor expiry.
errors.TRAINING_MANAGED_NO_EXPIRY: Training generated by the function accepts tags only, not expiry.

import.title: Import trainings
import.description: Upload a file exported by the app. Trainings are added to the ones the agent already has; nothing existing is changed or removed. Tags travel in the file; the expiry date does not.
import.notJson: The file is not a valid trainings export.
import.invalid: The file is not a valid trainings export.
import.version: This file version is not supported. Export the trainings again.
import.tooMany: The file exceeds the limit of {max} trainings per import.
import.imagesNotice: {count} text(s) with an image: the image is copied if it still exists; otherwise the text is added without it.
import.duplicatesNotice: Importing the same file again creates the trainings again.

reasons.TRAINING_ADVANCED_ONLY: Websites and videos are only available in the agent advanced mode.
reasons.GPTMAKER_UNAVAILABLE: GPTMaker did not respond for this training.
reasons.IMPORT_ITEM_FAILED: Could not create this training right now.
reasons.IMAGE_URL_NOT_SUPPORTED: Image not imported: the address is not from this service.
reasons.IMAGE_NOT_FOUND: Image not imported: it no longer exists.
reasons.IMAGE_INVALID: Image not imported: invalid format or size.
reasons.IMAGE_QUOTA: Image not imported: not enough space in the plan.

fields.tagsHint: Up to {max} tags of {length} characters. Enter or comma adds.
fields.expiresHint: When it expires, the training is removed from the agent automatically. Leave empty for no expiry.

settings.title: Tags and expiry
settings.description: Organize the training and set when it stops being valid. Nothing is resent to the agent.
